description: Utility functions for Gmail setup, Google Cloud SDK, Pub/Sub, Tailscale, and GOG credentials management within a project.

methods.name: resetGmailSetupUtilsCachesForTest
methods.description: Resets cached Python path for testing purposes.

methods.name: resolvePythonExecutablePath
methods.description: Resolves the path to the Python executable, caching the result.

methods.name: ensureDependency
methods.description: Ensures that a specified binary dependency is installed, optionally via Homebrew on macOS.

methods.name: ensureGcloudAuth
methods.description: Ensures that gcloud is authenticated with an active account.

methods.name: runGcloud
methods.description: Runs a gcloud command with error handling.

methods.name: ensureTopic
methods.description: Ensures a Pub/Sub topic exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: ensureSubscription
methods.description: Ensures a Pub/Sub subscription exists with the specified push endpoint.

methods.name: ensureTailscaleEndpoint
methods.description: Configures a Tailscale endpoint with specified mode, path, port, target, and token.

methods.name: resolveProjectIdFromGogCredentials
methods.description: Attempts to resolve Google Cloud project ID from GOG credentials files.
